howto: Press Play to open the day. The bar at the top shows the clock and the day's takings target.
Tap Add to Cart on products (or Scan barcodes), then open the cart and Proceed to Checkout.
Checked-out sales count toward the target. Beat it before the clock hits 0:00 to clear the day.
At close, the day's costs come out of your takings. Spend the store bank on upgrades in Career.
tips: Pricier lines like Salmon Fillet ($12.99) fill the target fastest, but only a few are in stock.
Only checked-out sales count: don't leave a full cart when the clock runs out.
Scans within five seconds of each other build a streak.
Miss three targets in a row and the store goes into arrears: the target rises 15% until you clear a day.
Express Register adds 30 seconds to every day; Standing Restock refills every shelf at opening.

controls.keyboard: Tab to any button and press Enter. Ctrl+K jumps to search; type a barcode in Scan and press Enter. Esc closes a panel, P pauses.
controls.touch: Tap Add to Cart, the cart icon and the buttons. Scroll the page to see more shelves.

difficulty: Easy, Normal or Hard on the title card, between days. Easy days last 2:30 with targets 20% lower; Hard days last 1:30 with targets 20% higher. Targets and daily costs rise every day you clear.

cheats.effect: Every product line refilled to double its opening stock
+60 seconds on the day clock, today and every day while codes are on

features.goals-or-day-targets: Each day has a takings target and a countdown clock in the day bar; targets rise with every day cleared
features.economy-readout: Day bar: takings against target, day costs and store bank; product cards show price and stock; Analytics has revenue and category charts
features.upgrade-path: Career: Express Register, Wholesale Account, Loyalty Cards and Standing Restock, bought from the store bank; cleared days unlock five new product lines
features.end-of-day-summary: Close-of-business card: takings against target, costs, profit or loss, store bank, unlocks and what tomorrow brings
features.results: The close-of-business card with Start next day; Career shows the record board
features.tutorial: Five coach marks on the first day (the clock waits while they are open); replay from How to play
